explanation: Fires only during the original phase at steps 1-3 (95% of mass at t=1-2), never at the delimiter or during copying. It acts like a template match for the prefix 'a i h'. The input 'h' carries 75% of mass; preceding 'i'/'a'/'o' and a first token in {a,i,o} (also n, p more weakly) raise it. Activation is highest (max, 2.27) at step 2 of sequences that start exactly 'a i h'. Partial matches give graded, smaller activations: 'x i h', 'a x h', 'a i x', or step 1 'a h'/'o h' (~0.25 of max), and 'i h' at step 3 after a non-matching start (~0.1-0.2). The predicate counts a step-2 match when at least 2 of 3 hold (first token in {a,i,o}, second token 'i', input 'h'), plus step-1 'h' after a first token in {a,i,o}. Dev: P 0.88, R 0.70, mass recall 0.87. Misses are weak partial matches (first token n/p/k/j, prev 'a', step 3). It does not fire on 'h' later in the sequence or on 'h' after an unrelated prefix. False positives are mostly step-2 'h' with first token a/i/o but a non-vowel second token.
